flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4104 then book the free first visit class for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown and store the reference as 'ref'.
Get the booking reference code from the booking confirmation and save it as {{ref}}.

remark: click: Clicking dismiss cookie notice button
click: Clicking the Book free first visit button
wait: queued plan (2 steps): click "generic"; click "Continue booking"
wait: queued plan (3 steps): type "Name"; type "Email"; select "Arrival time"
wait: PRIMARY: confirm booking details for the free first visit are set
click: Clicking the climbing waiver acceptance checkbox
click: Clicking Continue to proceed with booking
analyze: the booking reference code is stored as {{ref}}
assert: a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown

summary:
Booked the free first-visit class for Sam Rivera using sam@example.com for November 2, 2026 at 12:00 PM.
Accepted the waiver.
The booking was confirmed with reference code PL-7302.
